items.title: Suspected serial violent homophobe walked free over gay bashing
items.description: A suspected serial violent homophobe linked to an Islamic State terrorist network has walked free on probation after pleading guilty to a brutal snuff-video-style gay bashing.

items.title: Albanese bomb threat is latest flashpoint in a risk already 'flashing red'
items.description: Spitting, assault and online abuse are rising signs of a dangerous political culture in Australia.

items.title: Bomb threat underscores complicated security environment
items.description: It's tempting to treat the evacuation of the prime minister from the Lodge this week as a bizarre outlier but that would miss the point.

items.title: Super industry sounds alarm about increased switching to 'riskier' funds
items.description: More young Australians with less super are moving away from tightly regulated super funds to platform-based or self-managed super funds.

items.title: Mother's fight for Deafblind child to access local school makes history
items.description: Australia's first Deafblind class in a mainstream school has been established after a mother spent two years advocating for her son.

items.title: 'Out of control' sexual harassment, gaslighting and broken promises affecting female athletes
items.description: Experiences shared by athletes who participated in the ABC's Elite Athletes in Australian Women's Sport survey found many fear "nothing is going to happen" when speaking out on gender-based violence and harassment.

items.title: Australian diplomats' families offered evacuation over Iran threat
items.description: The Australian government offers to evacuate the families of Australian diplomats and officials from some of its missions in the Middle East, with the prospect of US strikes on Iran leaving the region on high alert.

items.title: How much compromise is too much? Labor's capital gains conundrum
items.description: The hints are getting less subtle and Labor's plans on capital gains tax are becoming clearer, but a proposal laden with compromises risks undermining any intergenerational argument.

items.title: First-home buyer affordability no longer just a Sydney problem
items.description: The Australian dream of home ownership is becoming an increasingly unrealistic goal for young Australians, new research from Domain has found, with repayments on an entry-level house now averaging almost half a couple's combined income.

items.title: Two charged over alleged abduction and death of Sydney grandfather
items.description: Two men have been charged over the alleged kidnapping and death of Sydney grandfather Chris Baghsarian.

items.title: Trump's showmanship distracts from all that was riding on address
items.description: Donald Trump's showmanship and supreme confidence can easily distract from the fact that he had a lot riding on his State of the Union address.

items.title: New image reveals 'extraordinary' detail of Milky Way's central zone
items.description: A new photo taken by the world's most powerful telescope shows a six-quadrillion-kilometre span of our galaxy.

items.title: Australian jailed for seven years for 'betraying' the US
items.description: A judge in Washington has sentenced Australian man Peter Williams to 87 months in prison for selling sensitive information to a Russian broker.

items.title: Man dies, woman leaps from third storey as fire erupts in Sydney unit
items.description: A man has died and a woman has been taken to hospital in a serious but stable condition after a unit fire at St Marys, in Sydney's west.

items.title: Axed Biennale artist to take not one but two huge installations to Venice
items.description: Last year, Khaled Sabsabi was dumped from the Venice Biennale to avoid "divisive debate". Now, he announces his work will feature in both the main exhibition and the Australia Pavilion.

items.title: Mamma Mia! star Amanda Seyfried tackles her wildest musical yet
items.description: The Oscar-nominated star adored working with director Mona Fastvold to resurrect an astonishing religious figure in The Testament of Ann Lee.

items.title: Search for lost colonial-era paintings potentially hidden in homes
items.description: Experts believe "countless" artworks by a famed colonial artist could be sitting in Tasmanian homes, with the owners unaware of their true value.

items.title: Iconic Sydney Mardi Gras parade route added to National Heritage List
items.description: Nearly half a century on from the first Sydney Gay and Lesbian Mardi Gras Parade, which ended in violence, the route through the CBD has been recognised as part of Australia's heritage.

items.title: Controversial NT administrator apologises over 'hurt' from social media posts
items.description: Just a day before being sworn in as the Northern Territory's new representative for King Charles III, NT Administrator David Connolly has apologised over a social media furore.

items.title: Japan to deploy missile systems on island near Taiwan by 2031, defence minister says
items.description: Japan's government plans to deploy surface-to-air missiles on one of its remote western islands near Taiwan by March 2031, the country's defence minister says.

items.title: 'Unbelievable amount of water': Towns receive over 200mm in 24 hours
items.description: Some pastoralists have already recorded 215mm of rain overnight, with the coming days forecast to bring an additional 100mm in some parts north-east of SA and far west NSW.

items.title: Families of Swiss bar fire victims offered $91,000 as 'gesture of compassion'
items.description: Switzerland's governing Federal Council says it will make a one-off payment to severely injured survivors and bereaved families of the New Year bar fire in the ski resort of Crans-Montana that killed 41 people.

items.title: 'Doesn't the case have to fail?': Judge interrupts closing statement in Coles trial
items.description: The judge overseeing a bombshell federal court case has made a stunning intervention as the consumer watchdog makes closing arguments.

items.title: Childhood education student had abuse material on phone, ABF alleges
items.description: A Chinese national intending to study early childhood education in Australia has had his visa cancelled after Australian Border Force officers checked his baggage at Adelaide Airport and allegedly found "21 videos deemed to be child abuse material".

items.title: Alleged bomb threat against Gold Coast theatre over Chinese dance group
items.description: Shen Yun has been the subject of several threats, including one against Australia's prime minister on Monday.
